desc:
Ecom Swift LLC builds custom WooCommerce plugin development projects: a clean, standards-based extension that adds the exact feature your store or customers need, delivered with source code and a short guide.

## What is a custom WooCommerce plugin?

A custom WooCommerce plugin is a small piece of software, written for your store, that adds or changes a feature in a way no ready-made extension does. It might add a field to the product page, a delivery date picker, a special discount rule or an extra checkout step. It installs like any plugin and works with WooCommerce through its published hooks and APIs.

## Why custom code is sometimes the better choice

Most needs are covered by an existing extension, and we say so when that is true. Sometimes, though, the available options do too much, do too little or clash with each other. A large extension installed for one small feature adds weight and settings you never use. Two extensions that both edit the same checkout page can break each other after an update.

A focused plugin does one job and nothing else. It loads only the code it needs, it can match your exact wording and process, and it does not depend on a vendor who might change terms or stop updating the product.

## How a custom feature affects your store

Custom features usually remove friction or capture information the standard shop cannot. A personalization field lets customers tell you what to engrave. A delivery date picker reduces back-and-forth emails. A special rule can reflect how you really price, such as a discount for a customer group.

When a feature fits a real step in your process, you spend less time fixing orders by hand and customers face fewer unclear moments. The gain depends on how often that step occurs in your business, so we help you judge first whether the feature is worth building.

## What a well-made plugin includes

- A written scope, agreed before coding, listing what the feature does and does not do.
- Code that follows WooCommerce and WordPress coding standards.
- Data sanitized and escaped properly, so the plugin does not open security holes.
- Values shown in the cart, the order, the admin and the customer emails where relevant.
- A settings page in the dashboard for options you will want to change without a developer.
- Support for the block-based checkout, as well as the classic one where needed.
- A clean uninstall that removes its own data when you choose.
- A REST endpoint when an outside tool must talk to the feature.
- An installable zip file, the full source code and a short guide for your team.

## How we work

We start with a conversation about the problem, not only the feature. Then we write the scope in plain language and agree it with you. We build the plugin in a development copy of your store, never on the live shop.

We test it with a full order from cart to confirmation email, and try it with your theme and key extensions. The Basic package covers one small feature such as a product field. Standard allows up to a few features, a settings page, order email data and checkout compatibility. Premium covers a larger extension with custom pricing or discount rules, order list columns, exports, an endpoint for outside tools and developer notes.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Describe the problem in terms of what the customer and your team need.
- Check first whether a maintained extension already does the job.
- Take a fresh backup before the finished plugin goes onto your live shop.
- Ask us for the source code and notes so any developer can continue later.

**Avoid:**
- Asking for many unrelated features in one plugin.
- Editing theme files to add features that belong in a plugin.
- Installing an untested plugin straight onto the live store.
- Changing the scope halfway without agreeing it in writing.

## Who this is for

This service suits a maker who sells personalized items and needs custom input fields, a grocery or flower seller who must collect delivery dates, and a wholesale business with an unusual discount structure. It also suits an agency owner who needs a small plugin for a client and prefers not to build it in house.

## What we need from you

Send a plain description of the feature, any examples of the behavior you want and a note of which theme and extensions you use. We build in a staging or development copy and deploy through an administrator user created for us, never with your password. You own the finished plugin and its source code.
